searchText: Subject change: how feasible would it be to add a property to addresses called something like lastTouched, lastUsed or lastSent that would return a block number the last time a tx was successfully sent by the address? In voting systems, it would be nice to be able to exclude or otherwise handle differently accounts that appear dead (haven't had any activity in X blocks) Currently it's difficult to know what a quorum is in a group bc of the possibility of dead accounts. Maybe there are other good use cases for such information being available inside smart contracts? Is this a total non-starter? If so, why?
